نمتط (form VIII)
# نَمْتَطِ (namtaṭi) /nam.ta.tˤi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
# نُمْتَطَ (numtaṭa) /num.ta.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
